text: The authors cite Leike et al. (2018) for the insight that verification is easier than generation, then treat critique as a form of generation and hypothesize that critique of critique is easier than critique itself. They further hypothesize that this difficulty relation holds recursively, so each higher level of meta-evaluation is more tractable.
title: Wen et al. extend Leike et al.'s 'verification is easier than generation' to recursive critiques
